description: Get the text forecast for an NWS forecast zone. Returns named forecast periods (e.g., "Today", "Tonight", "Monday") with detailed narrative text — the human-readable, zone-level forecast written by local forecasters. Completes the alert-to-forecast chain: nws_search_alerts returns each affected zone in "affectedZones" as a code plus a type, and nws_find_stations returns codes in the "forecastZone" column. Only affectedZones entries with type "forecast" work here; entries typed "county" have no text forecast upstream and will not resolve. An entry typed "fire" has its forecast in a segment of the office's Fire Weather Planning Forecast: call nws_get_office_discussion with office set to the alert's "office" field, product_type "FWF", and sections set to the zone code; a fire zone code that is also a public zone code (e.g., "NDZ040") returns that public zone's forecast here, not the fire weather forecast. Marine forecast zones vary: many coastal zones serve a text forecast of wind and seas (e.g., "PZZ251"), while offshore zones (e.g., "GMZ056") and some coastal ones have none. Zone codes follow the pattern XXZ### (e.g., "WAZ315" for the City of Seattle).

zone_id.description: NWS forecast zone code (e.g., "WAZ315" for the City of Seattle, or a marine zone such as "PZZ251"). Returned as "forecastZone" by nws_get_forecast and nws_find_stations, or as the "code" of an "affectedZones" entry with type "forecast" in nws_search_alerts. Format: two-letter state or marine area code + "Z" + three-digit number.

name: nws_get_zone_forecast

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `zone_not_found`: Zone code is not a valid NWS forecast zone. `zone_forecast_unavailable`: Zone is a valid land forecast zone, but NWS has no text forecast for it. `marine_forecast_unsupported`: Zone is a marine forecast zone NWS publishes no text forecast for (availability varies by zone). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

periods.description: Forecast periods in chronological order, typically covering 7 days.

items.description: Single forecast period with name and narrative

detailedForecast.description: Full narrative forecast for this period, written by local forecasters (e.g., "Partly cloudy. Highs in the upper 60s. Southwest winds 10 to 15 mph.").

updated.description: When the zone forecast was last updated (ISO 8601 with timezone offset).

title: Nws Get Zone Forecast
